name: North Light
flavor: One of three lighthouses. See the Harbor Light triangle once you've visited all three.

beats.title: No Keeper on the Roster
beats.body: The light works — bulb changed, glass clean — but no one on the current campus staff list is assigned to it, and nobody's claiming the job.

beats.title: The Logbook
beats.body: A logbook by the door has entries going back further than anyone currently enrolled. One page lists ships turned back 'before the collapse' — not shipwrecks avoided. Ships turned away from something.

beats.title: Longer Than It Needs To
beats.body: The most recent entry, dated this week, just notes that the light's been staying on a little longer than it needs to lately. It doesn't sound worried. It sounds like an old habit being kept up.
